sections.Profile:
The Jungle pinball machine, manufactured by Williams Electronic Games in 1960, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game designed by Harry Mabs with artwork by George Molentin. It features a jungle and hunting theme, with unique backbox animations where jungle animals appear behind undergrowth.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Backbox Gimmick, Hunting, Guns, Animals, Single level playfield
